tasks.title: USB drive storage
tasks.prompt: Open the box, place the USB drives inside, then return and close it.

tasks.title: Keyboard pushback with obstacle avoidance
tasks.prompt: Put the headphones and USB drive in the box, the pen in its holder, and push back the keyboard.

tasks.title: Bookshelf organization
tasks.prompt: Return both books to their correct slots, spines outward, and align them.

tasks.title: Skincare and cosmetics organization
tasks.prompt: Organize the bottles and return the fallen bottle upright to its proper place.

tasks.title: Watch and earbud charging
tasks.prompt: Place the watch on the wireless charger, then pick up the earbuds and place them on the charger.

tasks.title: Medicine retrieval and return
tasks.prompt: Retrieve the medicine from the drawer, hand it to the user, then return it and close the drawer.

tasks.title: Bedtime item preparation
tasks.prompt: Place the phone on the wireless charger, store the glasses, and turn on the nightlight or humidifier.

tasks.title: Object retrieval from a drawer
tasks.prompt: Retrieve the hair tie or hair clip from the drawer, place it on the table, then close the drawer.

tasks.title: Food-waste sorting
tasks.prompt: Empty the food scraps into the food-waste bin, return the plate, and put the wrapper in the general-waste bin.

tasks.title: Cucumber preparation
tasks.prompt: Secure the cucumber in the cutting-board groove, cut two even slices, then return the knife to its holder.

tasks.title: Parcel unpacking
tasks.prompt: Cut the packing tape and take out the items.

tasks.title: Parcel packing and sealing
tasks.prompt: Put in the items and seal the box.

corrections.title: Step 2 · Retrieve & place the filter
corrections.description: Recover from a missed rack pickup, regrasp the filter, and continue placement onto the cup.

corrections.title: Step 7 · Remove & transfer the filter
corrections.description: Adjust the grasp at the cup rim, lift the filter clear, and continue the transfer.
